entities.text: Pasunoori Venkatesh vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.No.1 of 2024
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.13417 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhitha, 2023 by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 4 to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.740 of 2022 of Police Station Jadcherla, Mahabubnagar District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A r/w 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.
2.

It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.No.1 of 2024 has been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 26.11.2024, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 28.11.2024 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.No.1 of 2024 is allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 4 in Crime No.740 of 2022 of Police Station Jadcherla, Mahabubnagar District, are hereby quashed.

Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
_____________________ JUVVADI SRIDEVI, J Date: 06.12.2024 Ksk Pasunoori Venkatesh vs The State Of Telangana on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198158323/
